2609.05261.title: Trace2Tower: Transition-Aware EigenTrace Induction of Multi-Level Skills for LLM Agents
2609.05261.paper_summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on execution traces to master complex interactive tasks. However, current paradigms are bottlenecked by shallow trajectory retrieval and flat skill summarization, fundamentally ignoring the temporal dependencies and outcome-conditioned topology of agent behavior. We introduce Trace2Tower, a transition-aware EigenTrace framework that distills raw trajectories into a robust skill hierarchy. Trace2Tower abstracts step-level interactions into canonical events, constructing a unified graph governed by semantic compatibility, transition dynamics, and outcome evidence. Through a novel contrastive spectral decomposition, it isolates stable, success-aligned behavioral modes while rigorously suppressing failure-prone shortcuts. These modes organically populate a dynamic skill tower of action templates, procedural routines, and overarching task strategies, continuously refined via verifier-guided feedback. On ALFWorld, Trace2Tower achieves 87.31% success requiring only 10.35 steps and 0.26 invalid actions; on WebShop, it reaches 50.67% exact success. Across both benchmarks, Trace2Tower significantly outperforms existing baselines in task mastery and context-efficient experience reuse.
2609.05261.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理越來越依賴執行痕跡來掌握複雜的互動任務。<lb/>然而，目前的範式受到淺層軌跡檢索和扁平技能總結的瓶頸，根本忽略了代理行為的時間依賴性和結果條件拓撲。<lb/>我們引入了Trace2Tower，一個具過渡意識的EigenTrace框架，將原始軌跡提煉為穩健的技能層級。<lb/>Trace2Tower將步驟級別的互動抽象為典型事件，構建一個由語義相容性、過渡動態和結果證據所主導的統一圖。<lb/>通過一種新穎的對比光譜分解，它隔離穩定的、與成功對齊的行為模式，同時嚴格抑制易失敗的捷徑。<lb/>這些模式有機地填充了一個動態技能塔，包括行動模板、程序性例程和總體任務策略，並通過驗證者引導的反饋不斷精煉。<lb/>在ALFWorld上，Trace2Tower達成了87.31%的成功率，只需10.35步和0.26次無效行動；在WebShop上，它達到了50.67%的精確成功率。<lb/>在這兩個基準上，Trace2Tower在任務掌握和上下文高效經驗重用方面顯著超越了現有基準。
